title: Chapter 286
text:
The cold night wind blew in through the window, and the humming sound of the lathe running filled his ears. It was a little noisy. Han Xiao casually chatted with Lu Qian.

"Your shop has been around for a long time. How's the business?"

Lu Qian's hair was tied up, and she was wearing a protective mask. She was welding metal with her head down. She did not even look up when she heard the question. "The location is so remote. Of course, the business is not good."

"When I came in, I saw that you were quite busy."

Lu Qian shook her head. "I'm the only one in the shop. There's a lot of orders. Of course, I have things to do all the time."

"Don't you need help?"

Lu Qian paused and sighed softly. "I did. I left."

"Probably because the salary is too low." Han Xiao shook his head.

"Is that the reason?" Lu Qian's tone was suspicious.

She was just an ordinary person. She did not know about those big events. Han Xiao left without saying goodbye and there was no news about him. Lu Qian had always been brooding about it.

The apprentice that she had painstakingly recruited was gone just like that.

Although they did not spend much time together, Han Xiao had left a deep impression on Lu Qian. In the past, there was only her and Old Man Lu in the shop. With one more person, it was more lively. The time spent together was quite happy. However, after waiting for a long time, Han Xiao still did not return. Lu Qian's mood was down for a long time.

"Since the business is not good, have you thought of going somewhere else?"

Lu Qian shook her head. "This is my home."

Dense footsteps approached. In the night, a field team quickly arrived.

At this time, the field personnel who was knocked out woke up slowly. His expression changed drastically. He immediately wanted to do a tactical roll to get up. Suddenly, a fist the size of a sandbag quickly approached him.

Bang!

In front of the field team, Han Xiao knocked him out with another punch.

"Don't move. Raise your hands!" The field team raised their guns and aimed at Han Xiao. The captain shouted, "We are Stardragon's Strategic Homeland Defense Bureau. We suspect that there's something wrong with your identity. Come with us."

Zeng!

A few cold lights flashed. The field team's gun barrels suddenly broke. The cut was smooth.

The captain's expression changed. "Requesting …"

Bang bang bang!

Lu Qian's vision blurred. Han Xiao, who had been sitting on the chair a second ago, was now standing in the middle of the crowd. The aggressive field team fell to the ground in the blink of an eye. With his attributes, it was easy for him to knock out this group of normal field soldiers who were around level ten.

"The security here is too weak. I hope that Division 13 can increase the number of guards here. Hmm, it would be best if the players who come here to complete the mission can't even enter the door."

Han Xiao shook his head and took out several thick stacks of cash. He placed them on the table and turned to leave.

Lu Qian returned to her senses and stared at Han Xiao's back. She suddenly asked, "Have we met before?"

Han Xiao didn't even turn his head. He chuckled and said, "Never seen him before."

When his figure disappeared into the night, Lu Qian put down what she was doing and took off her protective mask. She brushed her hair behind her ear and suddenly smiled, revealing a knowing smile.

…

After sneaking out of the Western Capital, he boarded the helicopter and returned to the sanctuary. Only then did he take out the four blueprints and examine them carefully.

Blueprint – Magnetic Shield Chain Floating Shuttle

Blueprint – Sonic Sphere – Pierce

Blueprint – Sonic Sphere – Shock

Blueprint – Sonic Sphere – Probe

These four types of machines formed an independent combat system with both offense and defense. The three different types of Sonic Spheres were the core equipment. They had different functions, but they complemented each other. As the name suggested, the Sonic Sphere's principle was related to sound wave attacks.

Ultrasonic and infrasound waves were of the penetrating type and focused on damage. Noise waves and strong sound waves were of the vibrating type and focused on control. Probe type was of the auxiliary type and was related to sonar detection. It could also increase the power of the other two types of Sonic Spheres. It could also transform and adjust the environmental sound within a certain area to form a special area that could amplify sound waves. It also had an mp3 function.

The learning requirement of these four blueprints was LV 45 and 250 INT. The required knowledge was [Basic Acoustics Lv.5], [Basic Mechanical Engineering Lv.5], [Basic Energy Theory Lv.5], [Basic Energy Conversion Lv.5], [Basic Wide Area Sensing Lv.3], and [Basic Electromagnetic Theory Lv.4]. Han Xiao currently had 68 potential points. He spent 12 points to level up the knowledge and fulfilled the learning requirements.

One day later, Han Xiao returned to the sanctuary and immediately started building.

The core principle of the Sonic Sphere was acoustics. The most important part was the transmitter of the sound wave attack. It needed to use electromagnetic sheets to form pipes that condensed the sound frequency. According to the different sound wave attack types, the details had to be adjusted. Furthermore, connecting all these pipes together to form a three-dimensional spherical frame was very difficult. He spent a lot of time before finally building the finished product.

Three metal balls lay quietly on the bed of the lathe. They were about two-thirds the size of a human head. They were not perfectly round but had some edges. The exterior was cold armor to protect the core. In the gaps of the armor, there were nozzles that released sound wave attacks.

The original control method was hand signals and whistles. Han Xiao changed it to Nerve Connection Control. He wore a special earpiece that converted the neuron signals within a radius of sixty meters. The signals were recognized by the receiver inside the Sonic Sphere to achieve the purpose of control.

"Get up." Han Xiao had a thought.

The armor at the bottom of the three Sonic Spheres opened up, revealing black holes. They spat out white flames and flew up slowly, floating in midair. The Sonic Spheres had the ability to fly and could move nimbly in the air. It was a mid-range combat method. Han Xiao familiarized himself with the control method. His mind flashed.

He then tested the power of the Sonic Spheres. He observed for a while. Sonic Sphere – Pierce had an attack range of twenty meters. The Pierce type was mainly used to kill the target. The ultrasonic and infrasound pulses could cause a large amount of armor piercing damage. They could attack the target through obstacles. The attack range was linear and inverted.

Sonic Sphere – Pierce had a base attack of 81 – 130. It did not seem high, but it was not. The specialty of the sound wave attack was high armor piercing. The damage reduction was very low. In addition to Han Xiao's attributes and skill bonuses, one shot could cause 350 – 400 damage. If critical hit and Flaming Will were added, it would be like chasing the wind and moon without mercy. The same type of explosive damage was not inferior to the Ghost Sniper Rifle that had a base attack of more than 250. Moreover, the output of Sonic Sphere – Pierce was more stable than the Ghost Sniper Rifle. It could be used as a main battle method.

Sonic Sphere – Quake was an area control method. When the sphere vibrated, it would release a high-frequency sound wave, noise wave, and strong vibration, causing stun, shock, paralysis, and other negative effects. The attack range was a circle with a diameter of ten meters. Sonic Sphere – Probe was a sound wave amplification area with a diameter of one hundred meters, increasing damage and effects.

Dong!

Sonic Sphere – Pierce suddenly increased its speed and created a dent in the steel wall, letting out a loud bang.

The structure of the Sonic Sphere was very precise. It was not used to collide with the wall because its head was tough but to test the internal resistance of the wall. This collision took away seventeen points of durability, and the durability of the Sonic Sphere was sixteen hundred points.

"One collision and one percent of durability is gone. If it is attacked, it seems a little fragile," Han Xiaoxin said.

The three sets of Sonic Spheres complemented each other. The defense was done by the Hovering Shield Shuttles. It was similar to the Magnetic Chain Split Blades, but this type of Hovering Shield Shuttles was used for defense. In essence, it was a 'shield generator'. The Hovering Shield Shuttles formed a shape in the air and connected with each other. The shape formed by the Hovering Shield Shuttles formed an electromagnetic shield.

Shield technology was a common technology in the universe, but Blue Star did not have a fully formed shield technology. According to the standards of the universe, this kind of shield that could only defend one side was a prototype technology, but it was considered a very rare machine in Version 1.0.

He could control four Sonic Spheres at most. Any more than that and he would be distracted, and his control would not be as precise. For a Mechanic, it was not that they could use all the functions of a powerful machine immediately. Many intricate machines needed to be familiarized with before they could be used flexibly. The skill level of a Mechanic was also reflected in the way they used the machines. It could be considered as micro control.

However, for the experienced Han Technician, not to mention micro control, he could control anything.

Including the Sonic Sphere system, I already have four normal battle strategies. The core system is the Amphiptere mechanical suit, and the other three are long-range, close-range, and mid-range. It should be enough to deal with all kinds of situations. I don't need a new battle strategy in the short term.

Han Xiao suddenly realized that he had stolen Lu Cheng's things. He did not know what Lu Cheng's reaction would be when he received the blueprint for the replacement. Old Man Lu might even come to complain.
